thread:
Alex Park: reserving the Newford private VPC change window tomorrow 02:00-04:00 UTC. I’ll own the deploy. Please ack if you need to be oncall.
Maya Chen: ack — I can be standby for smoke checks (02:10-02:40).
Theo Ramirez: I’ll handle rollback readiness and DB monitor. Are there any migrations in this deploy?
Alex Park: no schema migrations this time — just a config flip and a new model bundle. Rolling update of inference nodes with canary routing 10% -> 50% -> 100%.
Priya Nair: can you paste the smoke checklist and the exact rollout commands?
Alex Park: smoke checklist (short): check inference health, latency p95 < 250ms, error_rate < 0.5%, embedding checks for a sample prompt. Quick commands: 
```bash
# canary rollout
kubectl set image deploy/inference-newford inference=registry.redwood/newford:v2.1 -n private
# watch status
kubectl rollout status deploy/inference-newford -n private
# smoke
./smoke.sh --env=newford --quick
```
Sam Ortiz: I’ll watch logs and the error_rate alert. If error_rate > 1% sustained for 5m, I’ll trigger rollback and notify.
Maya Chen: I have KMS and network perms; I’ll validate keys and reachability at 01:45 UTC.
deploy-bot: Deployment window scheduled: newford-private-vpc 2026-04-12T02:00:00Z - 2026-04-12T04:00:00Z (slot #N-4721).
Alex Park: rollout plan: start 02:00, deploy to canary (10%) at 02:05, run smoke at 02:10, promote to 50% at 02:25 if green, full at 02:50. Rollback plan: kubectl rollout undo + shift traffic back to stable.
Theo Ramirez: I’ll run the rollback drill in staging at 01:30 to confirm steps and timings.
Priya Nair: audit/compliance note — snapshot logs pre/post and capture deployment tag. I’ll take care of log snapshots.
Alex Park: ops assign: @Priya will snapshot logs, @Sam will tag traces and watch the observability dashboard, @Maya will verify KMS/network, @Theo will be ready to execute rollback. If anything escalates, page @oncall-sre.
Maya Chen: I’ll join Zoom room: https://zoom.redwood.com/rooms/newford-deploy and will post a join ping here at 01:55 UTC.
Sam Ortiz: added a short runbook snippet to the runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/newford-deploy (check the "rollback" section).
Alex Park: thanks everyone — short ask: please confirm here once you’ve run the preflight checks (keys, access, smoke script) so we can go green before 02:00. :thumbsup:
Maya Chen: preflight done at 01:46 UTC — keys and network validated.
Theo Ramirez: rollback drill passed in staging at 01:34 UTC.
Priya Nair: logs snapshot complete at 01:50 UTC.
Sam Ortiz: observability dashboards pinned and alert thresholds double-checked. standing by.
Alex Park: perfect — see you on Zoom. I’ll post the canary ips and the traffic commands right before push.
